pages.text: The $(item)altar$() core: an echo shard, amethyst shards, chiseled deepslate and polished deepslate. The old builders' stone, my carving.

pages.name: Rift Altar
pages.text: Polished deepslate under it, a candle on each corner.

pages.title: The Eye on Its Center
pages.text: An altar without the eye sleeps. I set the little eye on its center and the altar woke, and it has watched me since. When I must move it, I lift the eye off first.$(br2)Awake, it takes what I offer and tells me what it wants. It keeps the three griefs for me too, each in its own measure.
